Hero.description: We help entrepreneurs and business leaders build and launch innovative custom software solutions to the market across a range of verticals & industries. We can help you turn your vision into a successful product together, whether it’s in the form of a Minimum Viable Product, UX/UI services, full product custom software development or help to scale your company.

About.description: At Tecrix, we specialize in providing cutting-edge solutions in the fields of instructional design and AI development. Led by Talha Arif, a top-rated freelancer on Upwork, we bring expert-level knowledge and innovative approaches to every project. Our focus is on creating transformative learning experiences and developing advanced AI technologies that drive success for businesses and individuals alike. Whether you’re looking for customized training solutions or AI-driven advancements, Tecrix is your trusted partner in navigating the future of technology and education.

Testimonial.text: We are very happy to work with Tecrix. The collaboration goes far beyond a standard IT service: with Tecrix we have a sparring partner that challenges us in our product decisions and is truly passionate about the results developed. The level of professionalism and dedication is exceptional in this industry and we are eager to strengthen our collaboration in the future.
Testimonial.author: Dr Amjad Saqib – Akhuwat, Chairman

CaseStudies.faveDesc: Fave is a fandom-centric community with highly engaging content where fans can create deeper and lasting connections. The vision to nurture and grow the community is centered on rewarding positive and meaningful engagement with points that can be redeemed for discounts and exclusive experiences.
CaseStudies.darazDesc: DARAZ IS A LEADING E-COMMERCE PLATFORM THAT HAS EMERGED AS A KEY PLAYER IN THE ONLINE SHOPPING LANDSCAPE, OFFERING A DIVERSE RANGE OF PRODUCTS TO CUSTOMERS ACROSS MULTIPLE COUNTRIES.
CaseStudies.foodpandaDesc: Foodpanda is a fully-owned subsidiary of Delivery Hero, a global leader in the food delivery industry. While focused on growing its core business in food deliveries, foodpanda invests heavily in technology to drive innovation and operational excellence.
